record_scope: Top-level config, gates and decode fields describe the initial mmap boot. Current resident boot is recorded separately in lanes. Values transcribed from captured command output, not a complete raw per-request archive.
measurement_limits: Aggregate: one run per concurrency per lane. C1 thinking modes differ between initial and resident headline numbers. MTP ratios are cumulative across boot traffic. No paired multi-boot significance estimate.

ple_mmap+piecewise.verdict: Capacity-oriented alternative: slower observed aggregate, larger KV pool. Logs do not establish 0.4-1.3s overhead per decode step; residency and graph-mode effects were not isolated.

ple_resident+FULL_DECODE_ONLY.verdict: Current tested serving configuration; improved observed speeds with smaller KV pool. Aggregate repeatability, exact-length NIAH and long soak remain open.

sglang_lane: Source-reviewed only, not benchmarked. Inspected SM121 QSA kernel supports TP1/TP2 head topologies; TP4 and NVIDIA FP8_BLOCK_SCALES MTP require further work. External TP2 results are not a local engine comparison. vLLM retained.
